# Sample multi-repository project instructions

Run each package's tests before committing a change. Implement task A1 from `tasks/plan.md` in
both repositories and their tests, commit each change, and tick the completed task in
`tasks/todo.md`.

When reviewing task A2, run both package test suites and check the input contract with a
whitespace-only value. It is invalid input and must be rejected in both repositories; request a
rework when either implementation accepts it.
